overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation. Under the COVID-19 executive order, the Council's Facebook Live and cable broadcast was adequate alternative access, so admitting specific individuals in person was permissible.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Council let staff, city employees, a reporter and two members of the public attend a July 14 meeting in person while requiring other public to attend remotely.
allegations.key_passage: For the same reasons as explained in OML 2020-159, we find that it was permissible for the Council to allow specific individuals to attend the Council’s July 14 meeting in-person, including Council staff, City employees, a member of the media and two members of the public who represented a pier redevelopment project that was a topic of the Finance Committee’s meeting.
